text.tspan: Share of population living in extreme poverty vs. mean income or
Extreme poverty is defined as living below the International Poverty Line of $3 per day. This data is adjusted for inflation
and differences in living costs between countries.
Average annual income or consumption (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes

text.tspan: and benefits) or to consumption, per capita. Where data for 2025 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2020 and 2026 is
